summary.text: Scott Rosenzweig is a Democratic state representative from Montana House District 57 who took office in January 2025 and is running for Montana State Senate District 29 on November 3, 2026.
A Bozeman business executive, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that affordability and the cost of living are his dominant issues.

paragraphs.text: Scott Rosenzweig was born in Tucson, Arizona, and earned a high school diploma from Westminster High School, a bachelor's degree from Wesleyan University in 1985 and a graduate degree from Cornell University in 1991.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has lived in Bozeman since 2005, spent more than 30 years as an executive in international satellite communications, and built and sold two companies in Bozeman.
Ballotpedia lists affiliations with Bridgercare, Bozeman Running Company, Scaling Montana and Frontier Fund II.
Rosenzweig took office in the Montana House in January 2025 and was assigned to the Appropriations Committee in the 2025-2026 session.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for State Senate District 29 and faces Republican Jason Gunderson in the general election, in a race with no incumbent.

In his survey responses, Rosenzweig said he would oppose a flat income tax and a statewide sales tax, and listed healthcare costs, public school support and protections related to data centers among his policy priorities.
